workflow: Clothing-only edit of the original eight-frame walking strip. Native geometry, protected pixels and final palette are enforced by the central exporter, not by trusting generated anatomy.
native_export_qa: Required after protected skin/face/boot mask and material palette registration; two earlier native previews exposed importer defects.

Use case: precise-object-edit. This is a CLOTHING PAINTOVER of an existing game's original pixel art sprite sheet, not a new character drawing.
IMAGE 1 is the EDIT TARGET: original assets/sprites/zombie/walk.png, exactly8 walking poses in one horizontal row. IMAGE2 is a reference showing an approved clothing-only variation of this same original strip. Preserve the original game's exact anatomy, pose, size, pixel clustering and lurching posture.
Edit ONLY clothing/equipment/hair colors and very small garment details INSIDE the original foreground silhouette. Every one of the8 original body poses must remain exactly the same: same head position and tiny14px head size, same shoulders, hunched back, hand positions, pelvis, knees, feet and the complete original alpha silhouette. The character is an adult58px tall at native72px cell size. Legs keep original40% proportion. Do not enlarge head, straighten posture, simplify into chibi or redraw the body's style.
Keep the original tiny face as its existing flat olive block and original single shadow; do not add or enlarge eyes, teeth, mouth, nose, eyebrows or facial features. Keep the original visible green hands, dark boots and dark #252018 outline unchanged. Replace the helmet's MATERIAL appearance with simple dark hair inside the same head contour; remove its metal shine/rim so this reads as an unarmored civilian. Repaint the riot plates as cloth, with no visible shoulder armor, knee armor, visor or metal breastplate. Do not add weapons or props.
Use the original restrained warm ochre/brown/rust/cream/olive palette and native pixel clusters, minimal deliberate folds. No smooth shading, gradients, blur, antialiasing, grain, dithering or decorative detail. Every frame must use exactly the same clothing identity.
Output genuinely transparent PNG, ONE horizontal row of the SAME8 walking poses and no other rows, no text, grids or checkerboard. A wide2304x768 transparent canvas with the single8-pose strip centered vertically is acceptable, matching the approved reference layout; keep all8 complete figures fully visible, separated into equal invisible cells and no cropping.
Specific civilian clothing identity across all8 original poses: Male worker. Muted brick-red long sleeve shirt with rolled cuffs; dark brown/charcoal trousers, plain leather belt. Very short dark hair replacing the helmet surface. No vest or suspenders, no armor. Original boots and original hands remain unchanged.
